pr_title: Reload keymap and locale config after firstboot writes it out

issue_context.title: systemd-firstboot: Tell the service manager about the system locale
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
I noticed that when I first install my OS, gnome-terminal refuses to start. It turns out, gnome-terminal-server.service does not know what locale the system is set to and exits. Looking at the code of systemd-firstboot, there is nothing I can see that adds LANG= into the service environment.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Either have systemd-firstboot do the equiv. of `systemctl set-environment LANG=[...]` or have systemd-firstboot use localed directly

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
For now, I have this workaround:
```
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/bash -c "systemctl set-environment $(cat /etc/locale.conf)"
```
comments: true, we need to trigger the vconsoled/localed/hostnamed logic when running on a live system at boot. It's a bug that we do not.

review_comments: this will only enqueue the job. I wonder if we should wait for it to finish, dunno.

Hmm, that's a good point. I copied the code from localed without thinking too much, but here indeed it would be nice to to wait. Although it's a bit risky to wait indefinitely, we should have some (short) timeout.
